signature: SUBROUTINE DLASET( UPLO, M, N, ALPHA, BETA, A, LDA )

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
Specifies the part of the matrix A to be set.

-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangular part is set; the strictly lower triangular part of A is not changed.
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangular part is set; the strictly upper triangular part of A is not changed. Otherwise:  All of the matrix A is set.

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: alpha
params.reference: The constant to which the offdiagonal elements are to be set.

params.name: beta
params.reference: The constant to which the diagonal elements are to be set.

params.name: A
lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,M)$.
